name: Soft (default)
description: Upper-left key light with a soft fill; Ycrystal's lighting since the first version.

name: Studio (soft shadows)
description: Large area key light from the upper left: soft shadows on floors.

name: Bright
description: Strong key and fill point lights; for dark backgrounds and skies.

name: Dramatic side light
description: Hard key light from the side with a weak fill: strong shading and shadows.

name: Top light
description: Area light from above: shadows fall straight down onto a floor.

name: Flat (no shadows)
description: Two even, shadowless lights from the front: low contrast for schematic figures.
